prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 1 "Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement, larger": indemnified in 1 of 2 earlier cases, t = 0 in 1; when indemnified t per pc about 1411 (80% range 1047 to 2122); revealed per pc: 1352-1445 (case 38)
- line 2 "Installation": indemnified in 1 of 6 earlier cases, t = 0 in 5; when indemnified t per pc about 482 (80% range 358 to 724); revealed per pc: 468-488 (case 38)
- line 4 "Freight shipping": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 42 (80% range 31 to 63); revealed per pc: 40-43 (case 38)
- line 6 "Contractor administration fee": NOT indemnified (t = 0) in all 8 earlier cases; no price evidence

items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement, larger cooling capacity than the damaged one)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.9 and 7.1.10: Only a like-for-like replacement of the damaged 3.5 kW unit is indemnified; the higher-output 7.1 kW model is an improvement, so indemnity is capped at the cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW replacement. Reference case 38 sets t for a like-for-like living-room AC unit at 1352–1445 gross.
Policy 7.1.9(c): Labour for installing a like-for-like replacement is indemnified. Reference case 38 sets t for installation at 468–488 gross per unit.

items.description: Decorative floor console (chosen for room appearance, not required by the new unit)
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.10 and 3.5(d): Not indemnified, as it is an improvement for appearance, not required for the replacement. Reference case 38: similar stand excluded.
Policy 7.1.9(e): Ordinary carriage of the replacement unit is indemnified. Reference case 38 sets t for freight shipping at 40–43 gross.
Policy 7.1.12: Surcharges for expedited/timed delivery are not indemnified unless agreed in advance or necessary to avert further loss, which is not the case here.
Policy 7.1.8(b): General administrative/handling/processing charges are not indemnified, regardless of how described. Reference: never indemnified in prior cases.
